 States With the Highest—And Lowest—Student Loan Payments 
 Four of the five states with the highest monthly student loan payments are in New England, but a mountain state claims the top spot for affordability. By Jenny Cohen | Oct 20, 2026, 10:00 AM EDT Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Shutterstock/jd8 Student loans can be a good way to help pay for college if you can't afford it otherwise, but how much you have to take out and how much you have to pay back can be tough depending on where you live,
--> Student loans can be a good way to help pay for college if you can't afford it otherwise, but how much you have to take out and how much you have to pay back can be tough depending on where you live,
 Outstanding student loans can vary by state. Some states have a higher cost of living than others, so going to college there could mean taking out more loans to cover food and housing during school. The types of jobs in the state can also contribute to higher student loans . States with more academic institutions may have more students, which means more people needing loans. And states with a high number of hospitals or medical institutions will attract more people who have accumulated high student debt.
